source_of_truth: Read by hand in src/components/EditorPanel.tsx (a 'use client' component on the initial route): line 2 is `import * as monaco from 'monaco-editor'`, a static value import of an editor runtime, client-reachable; line 10 renders <ToolbarContext.Provider value={() => monaco.editor.getModels()}>, a fresh function literal as the context value on every render (new identity each render); line 12 keys the list by Date.now(), a fresh value on every render, so every row remounts. React Compiler is not configured, so the provider finding is a real heuristic, not downgraded to info.
provenance: blind generalization: truth derived from source without consulting tool output

expected.rationale: monaco-editor is a heavy editor runtime imported statically in a client component; it reaches the startup bundle and should be dynamically loaded/measured.
the Provider value is a fresh arrow-function literal each render, giving every consumer a new identity and re-rendering them; it should be wrapped in useCallback.
key={Date.now()} is a fresh value on every render, so each row remounts every render; a stable id from the data is required.
